meta.name: Scam audit that survives an AI outage
meta.creator: chef.testnet
meta.description: A private AI classifies every token. If the model is down, over its limits or returns nothing, an allowlist classifier takes over, so the buyer always gets a report and is never refunded for a provider's outage.

params.policy: Flag SCAM tokens: URLs in the symbol, reward bait, impersonation of listed tokens. Answer JSON only.
